description: This file defines internal structures, constants, and function prototypes for the private layer of the 'concert sound bundle' in an audio processing system, including buffer management, filters, and various audio effect modules.

methods.name: LVM_ApplyNewSettings
methods.description: Applies new configuration settings to the audio processing instance.

methods.name: LVM_SetTrebleBoost
methods.description: Configures the treble boost filter parameters.

methods.name: LVM_SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for the audio instance.

methods.name: LVM_VCCallBack
methods.description: Callback function for volume control events.

methods.name: LVM_BufferIn
methods.description: Handles input buffer data for processing.

methods.name: LVM_BufferOut
methods.description: Handles output buffer data after processing.
